title: Light with a lens
kid_text: Aim a tiny bright dot. A grown-up does this.
safety: Do not look at the bright dot. It can hurt your eyes.

steps.text: Use a lens, clear glasses, a water bottle, or clear ice.
Aim a tiny bright dot on dark fluff.
Hold the dot still until it smokes.
A wide pale spot will not catch.
Move the coal into the nest.

mistakes.text: The spot of light is big and pale.
mistakes.fix: Move the lens until the dot is tiny.
Wait for a bright open sky.
